data.name: Attack on Titan 3 / A.O.T. 3
data.detailed_description:
Pre-order Bonus

Pre-order Bonus

Wings of Freedom Earrings

Use this item to customize your character!

Note: This bonus may be distributed at a later date as paid or free content.

Digital Deluxe Edition Exclusive Pre-order Bonus

Early Access

You can play the game starting 72 hours before release.

Note: All content included with the Attack on Titan 3 / A.O.T. 3 Digital Deluxe Edition is also eligible for early access.


Early Purchase Bonus

Early Purchase Bonus

Wings of Freedom Hoodie

Use this item to customize your character!

Note: This bonus may be distributed at a later date as paid or free content.
- The early purchase bonus is available to those who purchase the game by December 23th, 2026.


Digital Deluxe Edition Contents


Digital Deluxe Edition Contents
- Attack on Titan 3 / A.O.T. 3 Base Game

- Official Digital Art Book
An official art book that can be viewed in-game.
It contains stills of the characters and Titans, equipment concept art, and background design art.
You can view it by selecting Official Art Book under Extra in the title menu.
Note: Japanese only

- 3 Character Outfits
Everyday Outfit (Eren), Goth Outfit (Mikasa), Geek Outfit (Armin)
Changing costumes:
　1. Examine the mirror located in either the Workshop or your room.
　2. Select "Change ally appearance".

- 7 Character Customization Items
Character Customization Items: Everyday Outfit, Goth, Geek, Goth Hair, 3 Goth Earrings, Goth Choker, Geek Glasses

- Original Equipment Pack
Equipment part set Wings of Freedom (Cutting Edge, Grip, Grip Panel, Turbine, Anchor Launcher, Gas Canister, Scabbard) and 6 blade parts (Power of Fire, Power of Water, Power of Lightning, Power of Wind, Duster, Meat).
Available after the Workbench is unlocked.

- Starter Item Pack
Veteran Artifact: Artifact Officer Squad Leader’s Artifact, which slightly increases the performance of Scout Artifacts dropped by Titans and makes them a bit easier to obtain. Available after Artifacts are unlocked.
In addition, you can receive Special Weapon Enhancement Pack by following these steps:
　1. Speak to the NPC at the Materials Market in the Workshop.
　2. Select “Receive Supplies”.

Notes:
- The base game is also available separately as its own product. Please be careful not to purchase duplicate content.
- An Attack on Titan 3 / A.O.T. 3 Digital Deluxe Edition Upgrade Pack that does not include the base game is also planned for release.


About the Game

■ Experience the story of Attack on Titan from beginning to end

This title is a compilation of the Attack on Titan game series, allowing you to experience the story from its beginning to its conclusion. The game features brand-new story developments in addition to intense new battles against the Nine Titans, who make their first in-game appearance here. Memorable scenes from previous titles have also been rebuilt to offer a fresh experience.

■ Omni-directional mobility action—soar through the air and slay Titans

The omni-directional mobility action has evolved, letting you zip through the air with even greater freedom. Titans now move in more varied and unpredictable ways, posing an even deadlier threat. Together, these upgrades deliver intense battles where you read each Titan’s movements on the fly and take them down with flexible, responsive tactics. You can also turn on simple controls, so even players who aren’t confident with action games can pull off maneuvers worthy of a veteran Scout.

■ Assemble your own squad and undertake deadly Exterior Missions

A new feature, Special Exterior Missions, makes its debut in this title. Together with your squadmates, you will take on life-or-death missions in the vast and perilous world outside the walls. Faced with the overwhelming threat of oncoming Titans, whether you advance or retreat is a decision entrusted to you, the squad leader.

PC Features

- Support for various gamepads
- Freely customizable mouse and keyboard controls
- 4K Ultra HD resolution support
- Ultrawide monitor support
- Support for various upscaling technologies
- HDR & high refresh rate monitor support

Note: Availability of these features may vary depending on your hardware configuration.

Images are from a work in progress and may differ from the final product.

Notes: Attack on Titan 3/ A.O.T. 3 Digital Deluxe Edition is also available. Please be sure to select the version with your desired content when making your purchase.
To learn more, please visit the official Attack on Titan 3/ A.O.T. 3 website.
